steps.title: Predict
steps.prompt: A transect crosses 4 quadrats of 1 m² each. How many square metres are sampled?
hints: Each quadrat covers one square metre.
steps.solution: Four quadrats of one square metre each give 4 m².

steps.title: Explain
steps.prompt: Say in one sentence why the quadrats are placed at random.

feedback.saved: Compare your sentence with the reading.
